subject: TARGET CLAIM: Shizuku loss/reconnect transition recovery
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=reviewer-shizuku-recovery-gen2-20261001. Starting independent R&D against current main 45bb0d326899c0e08415928224cfea0ff58d2d4e. Scope: reconstruct and adversarially test what happens if Shizuku/user-service privilege disappears or reconnects during Fold7 COVER_PREWARMING/COVER_READY_HIDDEN/COVER_VISUAL/opening states, including mirror-session, cover lease/readiness, active close-cycle, and stale callback behavior. Initial source concern: Fold7ContinuityCoordinator.onPrivilegedUnavailable resets mirror-session/prewarm/readiness bookkeeping but does not obviously revoke mirrorRequested/controller visual state or cancel the active Gen2 cycle. This is a source lead only until modeled/revalidated. Explicit exclusions to avoid duplication: do not redesign state-rd exact CAS prewarm authority, display-rd compositor/presentation ownership, or performance-rd transition observability except where their contracts are required for recovery semantics. No GitHub production writes are authorized or planned.
